r01.text:
R01 Home / open
Open a PDF from this device or a URL, see recent files kept in this browser, and the privacy line.
States: idle with URL field open (web), phone, site blocks reading (CORS explanation); drag-over (web only; the phone has no drop zone) and empty recents in the doc.
Todos: C4b, C4c (recents: C7b)

r02.text:
R02 Loading states
Pages appear at their true size at once: placeholder, then a stretched low-res pass, then sharp tiles; sidebars show skeletons.
States: range loading from a remote host; whole-file download with progress when the host has no range support.
Todos: C3b

r03.text:
R03 Password prompt
Ask for the password of an encrypted file; it goes once to the worker and is never stored.
States: password required, wrong password (error under the field), phone sheet; worker restart re-prompt in the doc.
Todos: C4c

r04.text:
R04 Repaired / damaged file
Say plainly that lamina repaired a damaged file and what it changed, in a docked panel, never a modal; when nothing can be recovered, an error page.
States: repaired with details open; unrecoverable.
Todos: C4b

r05.text:
R05 Find in document
Find text across the document while it keeps scrolling: find bar, live count, results by page in the rail, match case and whole words.
States: results (“3 of 9”), phone with results sheet; typing, counting (“40+”), no matches and scanned pages in the doc.
Todos: C5b

r06.text:
R06 Rail tabs
Move through the document by outline (nested tree) and page thumbnails with page labels; Attachments appears because the file has attached files (full panel: O14).
States: outline with current section, thumbnails on labelled appendix pages, attachments; loading skeletons and no-outline state in the doc.
Todos: C6a (Attachments: E3f)

r07.text:
R07 Links and history
Show where an internal link goes before following it; Back and Forward return after any jump; web links ask first.
States: link preview with Back enabled; external link confirmation; unsupported link actions in the doc.
Todos: C6b

r08.text:
R08 Document properties
Everything lamina knows about the file: description, PDF version, page size, tagged, fonts, security, signatures present.
States: plain file; encrypted and signed variants in the doc.
Todos: C6c

r09.text:
R09 Print and Download a copy
Print pages rendered by lamina with range, scale and quality, warning when page appearance differs or the author restricted printing; Download a copy saves the file as opened.
States: print dialog, preparing pages with cancel, restricted-file confirmation, web More menu.
Todos: C6c
